about: All extra test cases (111 unique prompts on G1-G20, 110 on G21-G22; 2440 total), written by us. Same JSON shape as the senior spreadsheet column C. scoring.cases.load() reads this file plus agentic_evaluation_test_cases.xlsx. Spreadsheet AV-G*-001-006 are unchanged. Figures are from the 8-loan DuckDB sample (3 flagged loans, $59,160.03 / 36.5% REO, 4/8 90+, 8 loans / 757 records / $1,697,000, 3 active / $230,401.74). Cohort peers come from cohort_comparison on this sample, not from the unreproducible distances in spreadsheet AV-G2-005. G20 derived rollup remains a summary row.

inputs.UserInput: What is the original UPB, LTV, CLTV, DTI and borrower minimum credit score for loan 100023020488?

expectedResponse.Response: The response must report loan 100023020488 peak 0 months delinquent (never delinquent) and outcome active (still active at 06/2020 with last UPB $32,604.03).
